The owner opens room with model-bench.js limits --by owner (company/state/model-bench/limits.json, trusted only as the owner's recorded write). subscriptionPctPerRun: the share of this week's subscription limit one bench run may use (the pacer must also say the room is free now). meteredUsdPerRun: the money one run of a pay-per-use model may reserve from the money cap.
